templates.pacing_rule: morning: high-priority anchor (museum or garden); lunch: local food near anchor area; afternoon: second anchor + street walk + rest stop; evening: Bund night view + dinner
templates.commercial_rule: include at least 1 paid sightseeing ticket; optional: river cruise upsell; guide recommended but not mandatory for the Bund section
templates.route_story_angle: Shanghai in a Day: from 16th-century gardens to 21st-century skyscrapers

templates.template_name: Photogenic FCC City Walk Half Day
templates.pacing_rule: morning: Wukang Mansion photo → walk north along Wukang Road (stop at Romeo's Balcony, Ba Jin故居, cafes) → Anfu Road boutiques → lunch or cafe break → optional: extend to Sinan Mansions
templates.commercial_rule: free-dominant; commercial value in curated route knowledge—clients pay for the guide's eye, not for tickets; optional paid photography workshop or Hanfu experience upsell
templates.route_story_angle: Shanghai's Most Photographed Street: Art Deco, Plane Trees, and the City's Creative Soul

templates.pacing_rule: morning: Shanghai Museum or History Museum (indoor, interactive, free) → lunch: xiaolongbao near People's Square → afternoon: Nanjing Road walk → Bund viewing platform → optional: Huangpu River cruise (kids love boats) → dinner early (finish by 19:00)
templates.commercial_rule: children ticket discounts where applicable; family-friendly restaurants (no spicy, no long waits); private car recommended for young children
templates.route_story_angle: Shanghai Through a Child's Eyes: Museums, Dumplings, Boats and Bright Lights

templates.pacing_rule: morning: Shanghai Museum (2h) → coffee break at museum cafe (20min) → Shanghai History Museum (1h) → lunch at indoor restaurant (xintiandi or People's Square area) → afternoon: M50 Art District (galleries are all indoor) or 1933 Old Millfun (indoor, dramatic architecture) → dinner: Bund-side indoor restaurant with river view
templates.commercial_rule: minimal outdoor time; all POIs are rainy-day-friendly; private car recommended to minimize wet walks; guide value high on rainy days for indoor commentary
templates.route_story_angle: Shanghai Indoors: 5,000 Years of Art, a Century of History, and the City's Creative Present

templates.pacing_rule: morning: Wukang Road walk (free architecture + vibes) → metro to People's Square (Marriage Market if weekend) → walk along Nanjing Road → Bund viewing platform (free) → Yuyuan Bazaar exterior (free to wander, food at own cost) → end at Old Street
templates.commercial_rule: zero required ticket cost; all POIs are free entry or exterior-only; food is buyer's choice—recommend street food stalls for authenticity and low cost; no guide needed; metro card is the only transport cost
templates.route_story_angle: Shanghai for Free: Architecture, Street Life, and the Best Views That Don't Cost a Yuan

templates.pacing_rule: late afternoon: Wukang Road walk at golden hour (plane trees, soft light) → taxi to The Bund (arrive before sunset) → sunset photos at Bund viewing platform → Huangpu River night cruise (optional upsell) → dinner at Bund-side restaurant with river view → evening: Xintiandi or bar for drinks
templates.commercial_rule: high upsell potential: cruise (¥286/person), Bund-view dinner (¥250+/person), rooftop bar (¥150+/person); guide recommended for curated romantic storytelling
templates.route_story_angle: Shanghai After Dark: Colonial Lights, River Reflections, and a Table for Two

templates.pacing_rule: morning: M50 Art District (contemporary galleries in old textile mill) → taxi to Wukang Road → lunch at One Step Garden cafe (lane house garden setting) → afternoon: Wukang-Anfu City Walk (concept stores, indie bookshops, vintage shops) → 1933 Old Millfun (photography) → evening: speakeasy bar in FCC
templates.commercial_rule: medium spend on food/drinks; minimal ticket cost; value is in curation—client pays for access to hidden spots they wouldn't find alone; guide with design/art background adds significant value
templates.route_story_angle: The Other Shanghai: Where Artists, Designers and Coffee Roasters Reinvented the Concession

templates.pacing_rule: morning: drive to Zhujiajiao (1h from city center) → canal walk + stone bridges photography → boat ride → lunch at waterside restaurant (local freshwater cuisine) → afternoon: return to city; optional stop at Qibao Old Street en route
templates.commercial_rule: private car mandatory (1h each way); guide recommended for historical context; boat ride is a paid upsell; lunch is moderate cost; this is a half-day extension that converts a one-day into a fuller experience
templates.route_story_angle: Venice of the East: 1,700 Years of Canals, Stone Bridges and Riverside Life, One Hour from Shanghai

templates.pacing_rule: morning: Wukang Mansion photo → Anfu Road concept stores → lunch at FCC cafe → afternoon: Bund viewing platform (golden hour) → optional 1933 Old Millfun → evening: Xintiandi bar or Bund夜景
templates.commercial_rule: free-dominant; guide optional but camera-savvy guide adds value; paid upsell: Huangpu River cruise at dusk
templates.route_story_angle: Frame by Frame: Shanghai Through a Photographer's Lens — from Art Deco to Neon Nights

templates.pacing_rule: morning: Shanghai Museum (interactive, free, indoor) → lunch: xiaolongbao near People's Square → afternoon: Nanjing Road walk → Bund viewing + boat spotting
templates.commercial_rule: children discounts where applicable; keep walking < 2km; restaurant must have high chairs; private car strongly recommended
templates.route_story_angle: Small Steps, Big City: Shanghai for Families — Museums, Dumplings, and the Magic of the Bund

templates.pacing_rule: morning: Shanghai History Museum or Shanghai Museum → walk to Yu Garden (classical garden) → Yuyuan Bazaar exterior → lunch: local food → optional: Site of First CPC Congress
templates.commercial_rule: museum-heavy = low ticket cost; guide value is high for historical commentary; Yu Garden ¥40 ticket is the only required admission
templates.route_story_angle: Layers of Shanghai: 5,000 Years of Art, a Ming Dynasty Garden, and Revolution

templates.pacing_rule: morning: People's Park stroll (Marriage Market if weekend) → Shanghai Museum (indoor, wheelchair-accessible, free) → lunch at Peace Hotel (historic lobby visit, rest) → Yu Garden exterior or Old Street
templates.commercial_rule: zero required tickets; focus on comfort: frequent rest stops, private car, minimal walking (<3km total); guide adds significant value for elderly clients
templates.route_story_angle: Shanghai at Ease: Garden Strolls, Museum Galleries, and Stories at a Gentle Pace
